射向林奇的子弹被奥尔丁用真言蔷薇劈砍而发生偏移，打中了奥尔丁的胸膛。
“舅舅！”林奇从身后接住了倒下的奥尔丁。
“没关系的，伊萨里斯。接下来听舅舅说。”鲜血染红了奥尔丁的西装，就像是在他胸前画了一朵鲜艳的玫瑰。
“既然决定了要在超凡之路走下去就一定要努力，舅舅只是个普通人没什么能教给你的，这把剑你拿着，这是罗兰家族世代传承的禁物，名为真言蔷薇...是...”
奥尔丁的声音逐渐微弱了下来。
能打出暴击的火焰附魔子弹摧毁了他的心脏，那是林奇现在的最强一击，打在了最喜欢他的舅舅身上。
“舅舅，别说了。一定会没事的......”
林奇按住奥尔丁流血的胸口试图挽救他正在逐渐流逝的生命，他的眼前再次模糊起来，只是这次他分不清这是伊萨里斯身体的本能，还是他自己的情感。
从来到这个世界后奥尔丁就一直在照顾他，他虽然上一世是个孤儿但这一世他有个爱他的舅舅。
他很羡慕伊萨里斯，最起码他还见过父母，还有个舅舅。
林奇不是机器，他也有感情，看着这个曾经塞给他一袋金币的男人在自己怀中慢慢流失体温，他有了一种久违的感情难过以及悲伤。
“抱歉，伊萨里斯。舅舅不能陪你到最后了。”在林奇怀中感受到自己生命快要流逝到尽头的奥尔丁缓慢的伸出了手。
林奇低下了头，一只宽厚的大手盖在了他的头顶，正像是他们第一次见面，面对着客厅的两具杀手尸体，那个温和的男人将手盖在他的头上对他说。
“别担心伊萨里斯，交给舅舅吧。”
叮。

已解锁序列8平衡舞者。
“真是感人的亲情啊，道完别了吗？伊萨里斯少爷。”
格林收起了铃铛拿起了扔在地下的长剑，“别担心，我马上会送你们下去团聚的。”
“经验全部拉满。”
主职业：浪漫序列：序列8平衡舞者【lv10】
获得新技能：【引斥双衡】：拥有引力和斥力的你就像会舞蹈的舞者，无论怎样都会保持平衡。
“技能点加满。”
引斥双衡【lv10】
林奇抹了一把脸上的眼泪，轻轻放下奥尔丁的尸体捡起了地上的真言蔷薇。
“我会杀了你的，格林，我保证。”
誓言生效！
【真言蔷薇】
【级别：b级禁物→a级禁物】
格林突然感觉一股强大的吸力将他拽向了林奇。
“怎么回事？这是哪个序列的能力？”格林心中骇然，性格谨慎的他感觉到了不对，这股力量绝对不是序列9能拥有的！
“哈哈，伊萨里斯少爷，自己是个序列8，结果却让奥尔丁老爷一个普通人来对付我？
难道你这么怕死吗？怪不得你...会亲手杀了你的舅舅。”格林拼命的抵挡这股莫名的引力同时开口道。
“别被他激怒了，伊萨里斯！”洞悉格林意图的伊莱娜大声说道。
“放心吧，格林。我说杀了你就一定会杀了你。既然你不过来，那我就过去！”

The bullet fired at Lynch was deflected by Aldin's slash with the Mantra Rose, and hit Aldin's chest.
"Uncle!" Lynch caught the fallen Aldin from behind.
"It's okay, Isharis. Listen to your uncle next." The blood stained Aldin's suit red, as if a bright rose was painted on his chest.
"Since you have decided to go on the extraordinary road, you must work hard. My uncle is just an ordinary person and has nothing to teach you. You hold this sword. This is a forbidden item passed down by the Roland family from generation to generation. It is called the Rose of Truth... It is..."
Aldin's voice gradually became weaker.
The flame-enchanted bullet that could hit critically destroyed his heart. That was Lynch's strongest blow now, and it hit the uncle who loved him the most.
"Uncle, stop talking. It will be fine..."
Lynch held down Aldin's bleeding chest and tried to save his life that was slowly passing away. His vision became blurry again, but this time he couldn't tell whether it was the instinct of Isaris's body or his own emotions.
Aldin has been taking care of him since he came to this world. Although he was an orphan in his last life, he has an uncle who loves him in this life.
He envied Isharis, at least he had met his parents and had an uncle.
Lynch is not a machine, he also has feelings. Watching the man who once gave him a bag of gold coins slowly lose body temperature in his arms, he felt a long-lost emotional sadness and sorrow.
"I'm sorry, Isharis. Uncle can't stay with you until the end." Aldin, who felt that his life was about to end in Lynch's arms, slowly stretched out his hand.
Lynch lowered his head and covered his head with a generous hand. It was just like when they met for the first time, facing the two killer corpses in the living room, the gentle man put his hand on his head and said to him.
"Don't worry Isharis, leave it to your uncle."
Ding.

Lynch wiped the tears from his face, gently put down Aldin's body and picked up the Mantra Rose on the ground.
"I'll kill you, Green, I promise."
The oath takes effect!
【Rose of Mantra】
[Level: B-level forbidden items→A-level forbidden items]
Green suddenly felt a strong suction pulling him towards Lynch.
"What's going on? Which sequence of abilities is this?" Green was horrified. With his cautious personality, he felt something was wrong. This power was definitely not something that sequence 9 could possess!
"Haha, Master Isharis, you are a Sequence 8, but you let Master Aldin, an ordinary person, deal with me?
Are you so afraid of death? No wonder you... would kill your uncle yourself. "Green said while desperately resisting this inexplicable gravity.
"Don't be angered by him, Isalis!" Elena, who understood Green's intentions, said loudly.
"Don't worry, Green. I will definitely kill you if I say I will kill you. Since you won't come over, then I will!"
